$comment: Bugs of Toolshop's with-bugs release that this suite detects (see shared/bug-detection.mjs). Official bugs are referenced by their id on the official list (source.listUrl); the list is not openly licensed, so its text is not copied here: titles are our own words, and severity is our own rating (the list has none). cases: the cases that detect the bug. match: a JavaScript regular expression matched against each failure message of those cases (summary.json). blocks: cases whose precondition the bug breaks; the same pattern then marks them as blocked instead of failed. issue: GitHub issue number or null. evidence: optional image under docs/bugs/. unlisted: findings that are not on the official list (key instead of id). outOfScope: official ids this suite does not target, with the reason. Checked by npm run check:config.

title.zh-TW: 排序選項跟實際排序相反（選「高到低」卻是由低到高）
title.en: Sort options do the opposite of their label ("High - Low" sorts low to high)

title.zh-TW: 首頁商品卡片的圖片無法載入（破圖）
title.en: Product card images on the home page fail to load (broken images)

title.zh-TW: 調整價格區間滑桿後，商品列表沒有依價格上限篩選
title.en: Adjusting the price range slider does not filter products by maximum price

title.zh-TW: 頁首的 Toolshop 標誌圖片無法載入（破圖）
title.en: The Toolshop logo in the header fails to load (broken image)

title.zh-TW: 主選單的「Home」連結打開的是聯絡頁
title.en: The Home link in the main menu opens the contact page

title.zh-TW: 側邊欄「Search」標題旁的放大鏡圖示無法載入（破圖）
title.en: The magnifying-glass icon next to the "Search" sidebar heading fails to load
The "Contact" link in the navigation bar is misspelled as "Contakt"

title.zh-TW: 登入後選單不顯示使用者名稱，而是一段錯誤文字
title.en: After signing in, the menu shows an error text instead of the user's name
The "Sort" heading in the sidebar is misspelled as "Sorth"

title.zh-TW: 搜尋按鈕的文字「Search」拼錯成「Serch」
title.en: The search button label "Search" is misspelled as "Serch"

title.zh-TW: 商品頁的數量 + / − 按鈕沒有作用
title.en: The + / − quantity buttons on the product page do nothing

title.zh-TW: 商品頁的「Related products」標題拼錯成「Related produts」
title.en: The "Related products" heading on the product page is misspelled as "Related produts"

title.zh-TW: 加入購物車時跳出錯誤訊息，但商品其實已經加進去
title.en: Add to cart shows an error message although the product is added

title.zh-TW: 購物車單項商品數量上限變成 10，無法購買 11～99 個（規格上限為 99）
title.en: Cart item quantity is capped at 10 instead of the specified limit of 99

title.zh-TW: 聯絡表單拒絕上傳 PDF 與 JPG 附件（US6100 規定應接受 txt、pdf、jpg）
title.en: Contact form rejects PDF and JPG attachments (US6100 allows txt, pdf and jpg)

title.zh-TW: 聯絡表單的附件欄位未設定 accept 屬性，檔案選擇器未過濾為 txt、pdf、jpg（US6100 ACC3）
title.en: Contact form attachment input has no accept filter for txt, pdf and jpg in the file dialog (US6100 ACC3)

title.zh-TW: 聯絡表單允許送出 0 KB 空檔案與超過 500 KB 的附件（US6100 規定須大於 0 KB 且不超過 500 KB）
title.en: Contact form accepts 0 KB empty files and attachments over 500 KB (US6100 requires >0 KB and ≤500 KB)

title.zh-TW: 搜尋不到商品時，頁面沒有任何提示訊息
title.en: A search without results shows no message at all

category.zh-TW: 只在 Firefox 或 Edge 出現

reason.zh-TW: 這套測試只用 Chromium 執行。
reason.en: The suite runs in Chromium only.

category.zh-TW: 版面與樣式（字型、間距、對齊、寬度、顏色）
category.en: Visual styling (fonts, padding, alignment, widths, colours)

reason.zh-TW: 功能測試不比對像素層級的樣式，這類問題要靠視覺回歸測試。
reason.en: Functional checks do not compare pixel-level styling; that needs visual regression testing.

category.zh-TW: API 安全與 API 行為

reason.zh-TW: 這套測試透過瀏覽器測網站介面。API 安全需要專門的 API／資安測試，也不該對共用的示範網站做攻擊性的測試。
reason.en: The suite tests the web UI through a browser. API security needs dedicated API and security tests, and attack-style tests should not be run against a shared demo site.
The suite does not read e-mail.

category.zh-TW: 無障礙（對比、欄位標籤、Tab 鍵順序）

reason.zh-TW: 需要無障礙檢測工具（例如 axe）或人工檢查，不在這套功能測試的範圍內。
reason.en: Needs an accessibility checker (such as axe) or a manual review; not part of this functional suite.
